newsitem.title: USA: AMRE knows of no reason for stock activity.
newsitem.headline: AMRE knows of no reason for stock activity.

text.p: AMRE Inc said Wednesday it knows of no events from the past few days that would cause trading activity in its stock.
AMRE, the parent company of Century 21 Home Improvements Inc, said it was issuing the statement at the request of the New York Stock Exchange.
As of Wednesday afternoon, the company's stock was trading at 2-1/2, down 3/4 on the day on volume of 1,924,600.
AMRE said in a statement that it is not experiencing any cash constraints and continues to operate "in the ordinary course of business."

It said it is continuing to explore financing, which would be used to provide it with sufficient cash to meet its anticipated longer term working capital needs. For that purpose, the company said it continues to be in discussions with HFS Inc.
